messages.subject: Initialization failing on simple model
parts:
Hi all,

I'm having some troubles with a model failing to initialize. I've reduced the model to something dead simple and I can't see why it should fail. I've attached the model and data here. I'm running this through rstan.

data{
    int<lower=1> n_g; // number of grade observations
    int<lower=1> Ng; // number participants contributing grades
    vector[n_g] obs_grades; //observed gpa data
    int sub_obs_gr[n_g]; //subject-grade observation indicator
}
parameters{
    real grand_mu;
    real mu_grades[Ng];
    real<lower=0> sig[Ng];
}
model {
    grand_mu ~ normal(2, 1);
    mu_grades ~ normal(grand_mu, 1);
    obs_grades ~ normal(mu_grades[sub_obs_gr], sig[sub_obs_gr]);
}

Results in:

Initialization between (-5, 5) failed after 100 attempts. 
 Try specifying initial values, reducing ranges of constrained values, or reparameterizing the model.
[1] "Error in sampler$call_sampler(args_list[[i]]) : Initialization failed."


Note that I've tried changing the initialization range without success. I've also tried a couple of modifications to the model, but they all fail. For instance, this model yields the same problem:

data{
    int<lower=1> n_g; // number of grade observations
    int<lower=1> Ng; // number participants contributing grades
    vector[n_g] obs_grades; //observed gpa data
    int sub_obs_gr[n_g]; //subject-grade observation indicator
}
parameters{
    real grand_mu;
    vector[Ng] mu_grades;
    real<lower=0> sig[Ng];
    real<lower=0> sig_e;
}
model {
    vector[n_g] nu;
    grand_mu ~ normal(2, 1);
    mu_grades ~ normal(0, sig);
    for (i in 1:n_g){
        nu[i] = grand_mu + mu_grades[sub_obs_gr[i]];
    }
    obs_grades ~ normal(nu, sig_e);
}

So I'm clearly missing something pretty basic, but really can't say what it is.

messages.author: 3d7541308bd2e290
messages.subject: Re: Initialization failing on simple model
parts:
It looks like max(dat$sub_obs_gr) > dat$Ng, so I think this is an out of bounds problem. Change that around and see if the model goes to working.

Ben

messages.subject: Re: Initialization failing on simple model
parts:
Good eye - that did it, thanks!

But given this issue, the error is a bit confusing to me. Most of the tips regarding this particular error message suggest varieties of misspecified parameters as the culprit (as indicated in the message itself). Can you help me to understand what this error means in this particular context?
